Executor is a lightweight freeware launcher for Windows designed as an alternative to the standard system Run utility.

Created by Martin Bresson with a footprint of just 7 MB, it supports Windows 11, 10, 8, and 7.

The tool helps users open applications, files, and URLs quickly using customizable keywords, automatic completion, drag-and-drop shortcuts, and direct web address input while resting quietly in the system tray.
